text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City Policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting approval to prohibit standing at all times on the east side of Jameson Avenue, north of King Street West. This is in response to complaints about vehicles parking in this area and creating conflicts between northbound through and southbound left-turning vehicles.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Prohibited standing at all times on the east side of Jameson Avenue, between King Street West and a point 35.2 metres north.
